Owner request: one GitHub-hosted website from which all work can be checked out visually, and a home page for every project and product by default.

- `PROJECTS.md`: new milestone 9 `project-pages` (per-project pages generated by `site/build.py`, per-venture pages in oss-monorepo, builds enforce it), a "home page by default" rule for every track, and the intro's project requirements.
- `prompt.md`: Portfolio site section extended to per-project home pages.

`python site/build.py` → `ok: 393 projects, 3434 tests`. Docs-only change.
